AllowHQShadows.name: AllowHQShadows
AllowHQShadows.description: This value specifies if the object can cast a High quality Shadow. If set to false, only the Low (sprite) based shadow will render. Almost all classes support two Level Of Detail (LOD) models. LOD1 and LOD2 models are toggled when Object Detail setting in Graphics Options is set to Medium or Low, and based on either the user's Distance from the object, or the object's relative size on screen. Generally, LOD1 is used first at mid range, and LOD2 is used last at furthest range. LOD models do not support any Animations.

dontShiftLOD.name: dontShiftLOD
dontShiftLOD.description: This value, if set to true, will disable shifting of LOD values between LOD1 and LOD2, meaning the object will only use LOD1.

geometryName.name: geometryName
geometryName.description: This specifies the model name of the LOD1 entry. Model filename with extension, either XSI or FBX supported. Example: "ivtankL1.xsi"

radius.name: radius
radius.description: Radius threshold of screen size, determining how small the object must be on screen before considering switching to this LOD model.

distance.name: distance
distance.description: The distance from the object must be from the Player for it to consider using this LOD model.

baseName.name: baseName
baseName.description: baseName is used to override an object's base type identification. This is a quick way to set an object's F-Group unit Icon, Info key card, and Status display image name. By default, baseName will default to the file name of the ODF. For instance: ivmytank.odf will by default look for ivmytank.inf for it's Info card, icon_ivmytank.dds for it's unit icon, and wire_ivmytank.dds for it's status display image. Setting baseName = "ivtank" will make it try to use ivtank.inf, icon_ivtank.dds, and wire_ivtank.dds respectively. Though these can be overridden individually per ODF, this provides a quick and easy way to specify this object's base type.

unitName.name: unitName
unitName.description: This object's Name. This is what is displayed over the object's head, in the build menu, and Factory terminal panel. This string is also passed through the Translation table for localization.

unitIcon.name: unitIcon
unitIcon.description: This is the icon image that appears in the unit's F group. Default is the gCfg (baseName). _Note:_ This setting is not ODF Inherited.

unitStatus.name: unitStatus
unitStatus.description: This is the status image that appears above the weapons panel. Default is the gCfg (baseName). _Note:_ This setting is not ODF Inherited.

infoName.name: infoName
infoName.description: This is the Info key card that comes up when you press the Interact key while looking at an object. If not specified, it looks for the ODF name, with .inf extension. If that is not found, it looks for baseName with .inf extension.

ignoreMissingInf.name: ignoreMissingInf
ignoreMissingInf.description: If this is true, it will squelch the warnings about missing .inf files from this odf. _Note:_ This is not ODF Inherited.

canInteract.name: canInteract
canInteract.description: Determines if this object can be interacted with. Controls info card key interaction, point-space reticle interaction, being able to see health/ammo when looking at the object, etc. _Note:_ Default is false for: Boid, Terrain, Computer, CNozzle, KingofHill, ObjectSpawn, Person, Plant, Bush, Scrap.

nation.name: nation
nation.defaultRaw: race letter determined by the first character of the object's ODF name.
nation.description: This setting controls the default setting for if Factory/Constructor Chrome effect is used, and which type of Walker hierarchy is used. Both of these can be specified in their respective ODF Class sections, however. _Note:_ This setting is old, and only supports i and f.

ownsTerrain.name: ownsTerrain
ownsTerrain.description: If this object owns the terrain it is on. This registers this object's collision with the terrain cluster's collision map. _Note:_ Default is true for Buildings with terrain__h as their root mesh, or tunnelCount > 0.

isTerrain.name: isTerrain
isTerrain.description: Sets if this object is a terrain replacing object. If true, _Note:_ Default is true for Class: Terrain, Computer, CNozzle, and Buildings with terrain__h as the root model piece.

needPilot.name: needPilot
needPilot.description: If this object needs a pilot inside of it. _Note:_ Default is true for Craft. Only valid for Craft and Vehicle types. (Gun Towers are a Craft)

playerOnly.name: playerOnly
playerOnly.description: If this is true, only the Player can hop into this object.

canDetect.name: canDetect
canDetect.description: If true, this object can be seen on Radar. _Note:_ False for Class: Boid, Terrain, Computer, CNozzle, KingofHill, ObjectSpawn, Person, Plant, Bush,

canSnipe.name: canSnipe
canSnipe.description: If true, this object can be sniped. _Note:_ Defaults to true for Class: Craft, except for: AssaultTank, AssaultHover, SAV, Tracked, Turret, Walker.

canCollide.name: canCollide
canCollide.description: Controls if this object can be collided with. _Note:_ Defaults to true for Class: Craft, Flag, Mine, Powerup, Torpedo.

boxCollide.name: boxCollide
boxCollide.description: This changes the collision type to Box type, similar to Battlezone 1's vehicle collisions. It uses a rectangle box that uses the extents of each axis on the model to determine length,width, and height. _Note:_ Default is false for Class: Craft, Person, Powerup, Torpedo.

isAssault.name: isAssault
isAssault.description: This flags if this object should be considered for "Assault mode" when it is attacked. Certain AI Processes will use weapon hard points that are set as Assault, and morphtanks will Morph to Assault mode to attack objects with isAssault = true. _Note:_ Default is true for Class: Building, Tracked, Turret, Walker.

isSingle.name: isSingle
isSingle.description: If this is true, you can only Build one of this item on your team. _Note:_ Default is true for Class: Armory, Baracks, BomberBay, Bomber, CommTower, Factory, Recycler, RecyclerVehicle, RecyclerVehicleH, SupplyDepot.

isGrouped.name: isGrouped
isGrouped.description: If this is true, this object is placed in an F-Group slot. _Note:_ Default is true for Class: Craft, except for: Person, Turret.

needGroup.name: needGroup
needGroup.description: If this is true, this object needs a valid available F-Group to be able to Build it. _Note:_ Defaults true for Class: BomberBay, and Craft, except for: Person, Turret.

isLimited.name: isLimited
isLimited.description: If this object counts against the MP Unit Limit. _Note:_ Default is true for Class: Craft, except for: Person.

needLimit.name: needLimit
needLimit.description: If this object needs a free MP Unit Limit slot to Build it. _Note:_ Default is true for Class: Craft, except for: Person. limitClass1 ... limitClass32 = "" This is the provideName that this object limits against for the Team. limitClass1Count ... limitClass32Count = 0 This is how many of the corresponding limitClass# are allowed on the Team. limitClass1Text ... limitClass32Text = "" This is the Text displayed when you try to Build an item that has reached it's LimitCount. teamLimitClass1 ... teamLimitClass32 = "" This is the provideName that this object limits against for the entire Team Group. teamLimitClass1Count ... teamLimitClass32Count = 0 This is how many of the corresponding teamLimitClass# are allowed on the Team Group. teamLimitClass1Text ... teamLimitClass32Text = "" This is the Text displayed when you try to Build an item that has reached it's teamLimitCount.

isStealth.name: isStealth
isStealth.description: Determines if this object can be seen on Radar and Targeted with out line of sight.

CanSelect.name: CanSelect
CanSelect.description: If this object can be Selected via F-Slot or point-space Reticle interaction. _Note:_ Default is false for Class: CommBunker.

NoShadow.name: NoShadow
NoShadow.description: If this is true, the object doesn't cast a shadow.

ClipDepth.name: ClipDepth
ClipDepth.description: If false, this object doesn't perform depth clipping.

Permanent.name: Permanent
Permanent.description: If this is true, when the player who owns this object leaves an MP game, this object sticks around instead of exploding.

AllowSeismic.name: AllowSeismic
AllowSeismic.description: If this is false, this object is not moved by Class: Seismic.

Tuggable.name: Tuggable
Tuggable.description: If this object can be picked up by a Tug. Valid values are: -1 = default behavior, 0 = never tuggable, 1 = always tuggable _Note:_ Default is 0 for Class: Bomber, also Buildings, Tugs, and Turrets are never tuggable.

ScanTeamLimit.name: ScanTeamLimit
ScanTeamLimit.description: Determines which team(s) can see this object on Radar. Also prevents AI from targeting it if they can't see it. Valid values are: 0 = all teams, 1 = same team only, 2 = allies only, 3 = never visible on Radar. _Note:_ Default is 3 for Class: SpawnBuoy.

PilotConfig.name: PilotConfig
PilotConfig.description: If specified, this is the ODF of the pilot this unit starts with. Default is the race's *spilo.

alwaysClip.name: alwaysClip
alwaysClip.description: Determines if this object should always clip?

SingletonGroup.name: SingletonGroup
SingletonGroup.description: If true: GroupPanel (F Slots) can only select this group by itself, no others.

IdenticalGroup.name: IdenticalGroup
IdenticalGroup.description: If true: GroupPanel (F Slots) can only select this group with identical groups. _Note:_ Bomber class defaults to true.

DAMAGE_SCALE.name: DAMAGE_SCALE
DAMAGE_SCALE.description: This is a modifier of how much velocity is translated into damage upon collision. Calculation: _((Damage_Scale * massDifference * relativeVelocity) - 10) * armorRatio * shieldRatio_ armorRatio: N = 1.0, L = 0.75, H = 0.5 shieldRatio: N, A = 1.0, S = 0.75, D = 0.5.

Mass.name: Mass
Mass.description: This is the amount of mass an object has. If <= 0, it uses the default of Sphere(Width * Height * Breadth) * 800.0f. You can open an ascii-saved .sav or .bzn file with notepad to determine what existing objects have by default.

allowTLI.name: allowTLI
allowTLI.description: If true, allows Target Lead Indicator (TLI) on this object, assuming Server and Player preferences allow it.

allowMDMCollisionDetonation.name: allowMDMCollisionDetonation
allowMDMCollisionDetonation.description: This is a setting for if BounceBombs (MDM Mortar) explode upon contact with this object. Valid values are: -1 = auto (== hit non-building), 0 = never, 1 = always. [Applies to all bouncebombs.]

enableServiceTruckPull.name: enableServiceTruckPull
enableServiceTruckPull.description: Valid values are: -1 = auto, 0 = never, 1 = always pull this object when Service Truck serviced if moveable. Auto is classic behavior that this must be moveable & tuggable.

serviceTruckAutoHeal.name: serviceTruckAutoHeal
serviceTruckAutoHeal.description: This is a setting that controls if a Service Truck will automatically heal this object type. Valid values are: -1 = auto, 0 = never, 1 = always heal this. _Note:_ Setting this to 1 will cause Service Trucks to always heal this object, even if it does not meet their category requirements under [ServiceTruck]/[ServiceTruckH].

Lifespan.name: Lifespan
Lifespan.description: If this is >= 0, this is how many seconds, from creation, until the object is destroyed.

CanAcceptPowerups.name: CanAcceptPowerups
CanAcceptPowerups.description: If this is true, it can accept powerups. False if not.

AcceptPowerupMask.name: AcceptPowerupMask
AcceptPowerupMask.description: Bit Mask for what kind of Powerups this object can accept. Bitmask values:

DeployedPowerupMask.name: DeployedPowerupMask
DeployedPowerupMask.description: Bit Mask for what kind of Powerups can be accepted while Deployed. Refer to list above for values.

PowerupRaceMask.name: PowerupRaceMask
PowerupRaceMask.description: Bit Mask for which race's Powerups this object can accept. 27 total Bits, from a ... z, plus one for Powerups that don't start with a letter.

DeployedPowerupRaceMask.name: DeployedPowerupRaceMask
DeployedPowerupRaceMask.description: Bit Mask for which race's Powerups this object can accept while Deployed. See above for values.

MaxChromeDistance.name: MaxChromeDistance
MaxChromeDistance.description: If this is > 0, it will disable the Chrome effect of morphing/building when this object is that distance from the Camera.

ExplosionEnergy.name: ExplosionEnergy
ExplosionEnergy.description: How much Energy is passed into the Explosion. _Note:_ Only applies to Class: Building. Class Craft is read under [CraftClass].

xplChunk.name: xplChunk
xplChunk.description: Explosion Class ODF for when a Chunk hits the ground. Default is the race's *explosion.odf's value for xplChunk. _Note:_ Only applies to Class: Building. Class Craft is read under [CraftClass].

xplCrash.name: xplCrash
xplCrash.description: Explosion Class ODF for when the vehicle Crash model hits the ground. Default is the race's *explosion.odf's value for xplCrash. _Note:_ Only applies to Class: Building. Class Craft is read under [CraftClass].

ExplodeSound.name: ExplodeSound
ExplodeSound.description: The sound when this object Explodes. _Note:_ Only applies to Class: Building. Class Craft is read under [CraftClass].

LeaveExplodeScorch.name: LeaveExplodeScorch
LeaveExplodeScorch.description: If false, won't darken the ground when it explodes. _Note:_ Only applies to Class: Building. Class Craft is read under [CraftClass].

LightsOnlyWhenPiloted.name: LightsOnlyWhenPiloted
LightsOnlyWhenPiloted.description: If true, lights will be disabled when the craft has no Pilot, and toggle back on when a Pilot hops into it.

AlwaysShowAmmo.name: AlwaysShowAmmo
AlwaysShowAmmo.description: If true, it will display the Ammo bar under Health, even if the object is an Enemy.

SmartIsAirUnitCheck.name: SmartIsAirUnitCheck
SmartIsAirUnitCheck.description: If true, then it only considers Artillary, Bomber, APC, and SAV as "Flying". If false, it uses the isFlying flag which when the craft is greater than 2 * setAltitude from the ground.

AllowFactoryCustomizations.name: AllowFactoryCustomizations
AllowFactoryCustomizations.description: If false, this object can't be modified in the Factory Panel.

StayWithOwner.name: StayWithOwner
StayWithOwner.description: If this is true, objects that perform Construction in a TeamPlay game such as Class: Scavenger, ScavengerH, DeployBuilding, DeployBuildingH, ConstructionRig, will build the object on the same Team as the current owner, instead of it swapping to the Commander's Team.

AllowUndergroundSpawn.name: AllowUndergroundSpawn
AllowUndergroundSpawn.description: If this is false, objects with models that extend below terrain will be forced up if they are spawned via Script. If true, will spawn with the model's root position at terrain height. Default is true for Class: Building.

UseCollisionMeshForPathing.name: UseCollisionMeshForPathing
UseCollisionMeshForPathing.description: If this is 0, it won't use collisionMesh for pathing, if it is 1, it will use the CollisionMesh for pathing. Default is -1, which is true for isTerrain objects.

FactoryCustomizationMask.name: FactoryCustomizationMask
FactoryCustomizationMask.description: Bit Mask for which Weapon Slots are editable in the Factory Panel. Valid values are:

PowerupSlotAcceptMask.name: PowerupSlotAcceptMask
PowerupSlotAcceptMask.description: Bit Mask for which Weapon Slots can accept Powerups. Valid values are:

AlignTerrainReplaceType.name: AlignTerrainReplaceType
AlignTerrainReplaceType.description: Controls how the object snaps to terrain squares. Valid values are 0 - 5. Some experimentation required.

DeployOnBuild.name: DeployOnBuild
DeployOnBuild.description: Setting for if this object sets a Deploy state upon initial creation. 0 is force Undeploy. 1 is force Deploy. _Note:_ Bombers and APCs ignore this setting.

VehicleSearchFilter.name: VehicleSearchFilter
VehicleSearchFilter.description: Filter for what types of targets this object attacks. Valid values are:

TerrainBlendRadius.name: TerrainBlendRadius
TerrainBlendRadius.description: Setting for how many vertices around the boarder of a Building get blended to it's height. Larger values means smoother blending. Default is 3 for Class: Building.

MaxPostExplosionVelocity.name: MaxPostExplosionVelocity
MaxPostExplosionVelocity.description: Maximum velocity able to be added to an object from an Explosion. Default is 250% velocForward for Class: Tracked, and 50.0m/s for everything else. This is used with DamageIfVelocityClamped to calculate Damage from excess Velocity.

DamageIfVelocityClamped.name: DamageIfVelocityClamped
DamageIfVelocityClamped.description: Amount of health lost if Velocity is clamped by maxPostExplosionVelocity.

GameObjectClassServiceMask.name: GameObjectClassServiceMask
GameObjectClassServiceMask.description: Bit Mask for use with [SupplyDepotClass]::SupplyDepotClassServiceProvides to allow service.

GameObjectClassServiceMatch.name: GameObjectClassServiceMatch
GameObjectClassServiceMatch.description: Bit Mask for use with GameObjectClassServiceMask and [SupplyDepotClass]::SupplyDepotClassServiceProvides to allow service.

GameObjectClassServiceProvides.name: GameObjectClassServiceProvides
GameObjectClassServiceProvides.description: Bit Mask for what use with [SupplyDepotClass]::SupplyDepotClassServiceMask and [SupplyDepotClass]::SupplyDepotClassServiceMatch to allow service.

GameObjectClassPowerUpMask.name: GameObjectClassPowerUpMask
GameObjectClassPowerUpMask.description: Bit Mask for use with [PowerupClass]::PowerupClassProvides to allow pickup.

GameObjectClassPowerUpMatch.name: GameObjectClassPowerUpMatch
GameObjectClassPowerUpMatch.description: Bit Mask for use with PowerupClassMask and [PowerupClass]::PowerupClassProvides to allow pickup.

GameObjectClassPowerUpProvides.name: GameObjectClassPowerUpProvides
GameObjectClassPowerUpProvides.description: Bit Mask for what use with [PowerupClass]::PowerupClassMask and [PowerupClass]::PowerupClassMatch to allow pickup.

maxHealth.name: maxHealth
maxHealth.description: This object's maximum Health. 0 is indestructible.

addHealth.name: addHealth
addHealth.description: How much health this object gains over a 1 second time period.

aiAddHealth.name: aiAddHealth
aiAddHealth.description: How much health this object gains over a 1 second time period, when piloted by an AI, not a User. CondAddHealthMinRatio1 ... CondAddHealthMinRatio8 = -1 Conditional AddHealth minimum Health Ratio that this object must be for the conditional to pass. CondAddHealthMaxRatio1 ... CondAddHealthMaxRatio8 = -1 Conditional AddHealth maximum Health Ratio that this object must be for the conditional to pass. CondAddHealthValue1 ... CondAddHealthValue8 = 0 Amount of AddHealth done by this conditional. CondAddHealthFlags1 ... CondAddHealthFlags8 = 2147483647 Bit Mask for which Flags are used to enable this AddHealth. Values listed below:

DoBettyHealth.name: DoBettyHealth
DoBettyHealth.description: If true, does the Betty "Low Health" warning when the user's Health is below 25%.

maxAmmo.name: maxAmmo
maxAmmo.description: This object's maximum Ammo. 0 is NOT infinite.

addAmmo.name: addAmmo
addAmmo.description: How much ammo this object gains over a 1 second time period.

aiAddAmmo.name: aiAddAmmo
aiAddAmmo.description: How much ammo this object gains over a 1 second time period, when piloted by an AI, not a User.

DoBettyAmmo.name: DoBettyAmmo
DoBettyAmmo.description: If true, does the Betty "Low Ammo" warnings when the user's Ammo (or available shots in the currently selected Weapon) reaches 0.

aiName.name: aiName
aiName.description: AI Process name. This is the brains of the unit, and controls it's behavior. aiName is used for Player controlled craft, or if no aiName2 is specified. This must be one of the specified AI Process strings, and must be a valid type for the Class of object. Valid AI Names are listed in the AI Processes section. _Note:_ Specifying an incorrect AI Name will lead to crashes.

aiName2.name: aiName2
aiName2.description: AI Process name for Non-Player controlled objects, if specified. This must be one of the specified AI Process strings, and must be a valid type for the Class of object. Valid AI Names are listed in the AI Processes section. _Note:_ Specifying an incorrect AI Name will lead to crashes.

collisionRadius.name: collisionRadius
collisionRadius.description: This is the object's collisionRadius size, used for AI avoidance and path planning.

CanBeIdleVictim.name: CanBeIdleVictim
CanBeIdleVictim.description: If true, then this object can be the target of an AIP Plan's idle units dispatch.

DoBettyAttack.name: DoBettyAttack
DoBettyAttack.description: If true, will do the radar beep and warning Betty sounds when this object is damaged. ** Weapon Settings ** weaponHard1 .... weaponHard5 = "" This is the hard point name in the Model. The name must start with one of the following, and it must match exactly with a piece in the model. These traditionally have "HP_" in front of them, to make them Hidden Parts, but that isn't required. The following are valid Hardpoint names, with or without HP_ in front of them:

weaponMask.name: weaponMask
weaponMask.description: Binary bit mask for which weapons, out of the 5 weapon hard points, that the AI should try to use. 0 = don't use, 1 = use. _Note:_ The order goes from right to left, for hard point 1 - 5. So effectively "54321".

imageSignature.name: imageSignature
imageSignature.description: This is the object's Image signature strength. It controls how fast Image Launchers can lock onto it.

radarSignature.name: radarSignature
radarSignature.description: This is the object's Radar signature strength. It controls how fast Radar and Torpedo Launchers can lock onto it.

heatSignature.name: heatSignature
heatSignature.description: This is the object's Heat signature strength. It controls how fast Thermal Launchers can lock onto it, and how strongly Thermal Missiles are attracted to it.

armorClass.name: armorClass
armorClass.description: This object's Armor type. Valid values are:

shieldClass.name: shieldClass
shieldClass.description: This object's Shield type. Valid values are:

hitType.name: hitType
hitType.description: What kind of explosion is used when an ordnance hits this object. Valid values are:

explosionName.name: explosionName
explosionName.description: If specified, this is the explosion ODF to use. For iexample: explosionName = "xbldxpl". Default if not specified is chosen from the race's explosion.odf based on this object's type. damageEffect1 ... damageEffect4 = "dmgvhcl1" ... "dmgvhcl4" These are the Renders for the Damage Smoke. Below is a list of when they are used:

scrapCost.name: scrapCost
scrapCost.description: This is the amount of scrap this object costs to build, when built from a Recycler, Factory, Armory, or Constructor.

scrapValue.name: scrapValue
scrapValue.description: This is the amount of scrap the object drops when destroyed.

scrapReturn.name: scrapReturn
scrapReturn.description: This is the amount of scrap the object returns when it is Recycled, or it's construction is Cancelled.

powerCost.name: powerCost
powerCost.description: This is the amount of Power the the object consumes while it exists.

buildTime.name: buildTime
buildTime.description: This is the amount of time, in seconds, it takes to build this object.

customCost.name: customCost
customCost.description: This is the amount of scrap the object cost to build, if it's weapons have been modified through the user interface terminal in a Recycler/Factory.

customTime.name: customTime
customTime.description: This is the amount of time, in seconds, it takes to build this object, if it's weapons have been modified through the user interface terminal in a Recycler/Factory.

CanDropScrap.name: CanDropScrap
CanDropScrap.description: If false, this object doesn't drop scrap when it dies. _Note:_ Default is false for Class: Person ScrapClass1 ... ScrapClass3 = "" This is the ODF name of the scrap pieces dropped by this object. If not specified, it defaults to the race's *pscr1 ... *pscr3, respectively.

buildRequire.name: buildRequire
buildRequire.description: This specifies the requirement for building adjacency. It must be built on Terrain that matches this type. Valid values are:

buildSupport.name: buildSupport
buildSupport.description: This specifies what kind of building adjacency this object supports nearby. Valid values are:

ClearBuildZone.name: ClearBuildZone
ClearBuildZone.description: This setting controls if this object is pushed out of a building's build zone while it's under construction. For example: If you order a Constructor to build a building on top of a Turret, the turret gets pushed out of the building area. Valid values are: -1 = auto, 0 = never, 1 = always. If 0/1, overrides collide-able setting.

CategoryTypeOverride.name: CategoryTypeOverride
CategoryTypeOverride.description: This is the object's Category Type. Default is based on the type of object it is. Setting this to >= 0 overrides that. Valid values are:

requireCount.name: requireCount
requireCount.description: The number of requireName# entries it uses. Max is 16. requireName1 ... requireName16 = "" This is a valid odf or provideName that this object requires to exist on the same team before it can be Built. requireText1 ... requireText16 = "" This is the Text that is displayed when you try to Build an item missing the corresponding requireName entry.

provideCount.name: provideCount
provideCount.description: The number of entries this object Provides for Requirements. Max is 32. _Note:_ If this is <=0, the object still provides it's ODF name. provideName1 ... provideName32 This is the Name that this object provides for Requirements.

upgradeName.name: upgradeName
upgradeName.description: The ODF name that this object can be Upgraded to, if specified.

FactoryWeaponConfig.name: FactoryWeaponConfig
FactoryWeaponConfig.description: This is a setting for what weapon.odf list is used for this unit when modifying it in a Factory Panel. If not specified, the default is the race's weapon.odf list. _Note:[i/] Must end in .odf, e.g. "iweapon.odf"[/list]_

geometryScale.name: geometryScale
geometryScale.description: This model's Scale. _Note:_ Skinned meshes do not scale well.

mrmFactor.name: mrmFactor
mrmFactor.description: Depreciated, old method of LOD for Skinned meshes.

animCount.name: animCount
animCount.description: Number of Animations to load for this object. animName1 ... animName# = "" Name for Animation. Some classes play animations on their own. See list of supported AnimNames for each Class. animFile1 ... animFile# = "" Model file name for the specified Animation. Can be .XSI or .FBX _Note:_ You can use .XSI files with a .FBX geometryName, as long as the hierarchy matches.

cockpitName.name: cockpitName
cockpitName.description: Model file name for the Cockpit model. Can be .XSI or .FBX

animCountCockpit.name: animCountCockpit
animCountCockpit.description: Number of Animations to load for Cockpit model. animNameCockpit1 ... animNameCockpit# = "" Name for Animation. See list of supported AnimNames for each Class. animFileCockpit1 ... animFileCockpit# = "" Model file name for the specified Animation. Can be .XSI or .FBX _Note:_ You can use .XSI files with a .FBX cockpitName, as long as the hierarchy matches.

collisionName.name: collisionName
collisionName.description: If specified, this is used as the collision model. _Note:_ This overrides default collision, or any __c meshes in the geometryName mesh.

collisionScale.name: collisionScale
collisionScale.description: Scale for collisionName mesh. lightHard1 ... lightHard8 = "" This is the model hard point name for the Light. Must be a valid model piece name, no other name restrictions. Typically "HP_Light_#". lightName1 ... lightName8 This is the ODF name for the corresponding light. effectHard1 ... effectHard16 = "" Model hard point for this Effect. No naming restrictions, but conventionally "HP_Emit_#" effectName1 ... effectName16 This is the Render name for the Effect. effectMinAltitude1 ... effectMinAltitude16 = -1e30 Minimum altitude below ground / water that this effect renders. effectMaxAltitude1 ... effectMaxAltitude16 = 1e30 Maximum altitude above ground / water that this effect renders. effectMinVelocity1 ... effectMinVelocity16 = -1.0f If this is >= 0: The minimum velocity this object has to be moving for this effect to render. effectMaxVelocity1 ... effectMaxVelocity16 = -1.0f If this is >= 0: The maximum velocity this object can be moving for the effect to render. effectMinHealth1 ... effectMinHealth16 = -1.0f If this is >= 0: The minimum Health Ratio for this effect to render. Valid values are -1.0 ... 1.0 effectMaxHealth1 ... effectMaxHealth16 = -1.0f If this is >= 0: The maximum Health Ratio for this effect to render. Valid values are -1.0 ... 1.0 effectMinAmmo1 ... effectMinAmmo16 = -1.0f If this is >= 0: The minimum Ammo Ratio for this effect to render. Valid values are -1.0 ... 1.0 effectMaxAmmo1 ... effectMaxAmmo16 = -1.0f If this is >= 0: The maximum Ammo Ratio for this effect to render. Valid values are -1.0 ... 1.0 effectFlags1 ... effectFlags16 If this is >= 0: Bit Mask for Effect Flags for this effect to render. Values listed below:

EffectsMask.name: EffectsMask
EffectsMask.description: Starting Effect mask. Bit Mask of which Effects are enabled. _Note:_ Mission Scripts can change the Effect Mask.

LightsOnEffectsMask.name: LightsOnEffectsMask
LightsOnEffectsMask.description: Bit Mask for toggling effects when lights are turned on. _Note:_ Only disables effects.

LightsOffEffectsMask.name: LightsOffEffectsMask
LightsOffEffectsMask.description: Bit Mask for toggling effects when lights are turned off. _Note:_ Only disables effects.

InitAnimation.name: InitAnimation
InitAnimation.description: Animation name for an animation that plays on initial creation.

RunAnimation.name: RunAnimation
RunAnimation.description: Animation name for an animation that plays after creation.

CanDemolish.description: If this is false, does not appear in Constructor's Demolish menu.

CanAlliedCommanderDemolish.description: In an MP Team Play game, sets if the Commander can Demolish this object.

CanAlliedThugDemolish.description: In an MP Team Play game, sets if a Thug can Demolish this object.

DoBettyLost.description: If false, won't give Betty VO when this object is destroyed.

ReplacesObject.description: If this is true, then it acts like an Extractor and replaces the object that was under it. Default is true for Class: Extractor.

AlignsToObject.description: If this is true, it aligns to face the same direction as the object it's replacing. Default is true for Class: Extractor.

loadAsDummy.name: loadAsDummy
loadAsDummy.description: Largely depreciated, this appears to have been a way to load a Dummy class (Terrain), which was BZ1's version of Building, as a new Building class. (Skipping the loading of obsolete data). It was probably used in early development in 1999 during upgrading the BZ1 engine.

rangeScan.description: How far the Radar on the craft can see.

MinWeaponPitch.description: How far down the Reticle or Turrets can aim.

MaxWeaponPitch.description: How far up the Reticle or Turrets can aim.

strafeFactor.description: Scale the difference between the desired and current position along the right axis by this value when setting the strafe control.

omegaFactorTurret.name: omegaFactorTurret
omegaFactorTurret.description: Same as omegaFactor, but for Turret.

LookAtPitchFactor.description: Pitch Factor used when the craft is given the LookAt() command.

CanUserHopout.description: If false, the Player cannot hop out via the H key.

CanAIEject.description: If false, AI cannot eject a pilot from this craft when it dies.

ejectRatio.description: The Ratio for the chance that an AI Pilot will Eject out of this object when it dies. Valid values are 0.0f - 1.0f.

ejectVelocity.name: ejectVelocity
ejectVelocity.description: The Velocity which the pilot ejects from this craft.

DoIdleDispatch.name: DoIdleDispatch
DoIdleDispatch.description: If false, AIPs cannot send this unit out via Idle Dispatcher.

CraftTeamIsPilotTeam.name: CraftTeamIsPilotTeam
CraftTeamIsPilotTeam.description: If this is true, when a Pilot gets into this vehicle, the vehicle inherits the Percieved Team of the Pilot immediately.

CanAIPForceIdle.name: CanAIPForceIdle
CanAIPForceIdle.description: If false, switching AIPs won't cause this Craft to go Idle.

AllowLightsDeploy.name: AllowLightsDeploy
AllowLightsDeploy.description: If false, when a unit Deploys, it's lights are toggled off and disabled. When it Undeploys, it's lights toggle back on.

CockpitSniperRadius.name: CockpitSniperRadius
CockpitSniperRadius.description: How large the sniper dot radius is.

AllowLinkWeapons.name: AllowLinkWeapons
AllowLinkWeapons.description: If this is true, allows weaponLinking, assuming other restrictions don't apply such as MP server setting or Play option for Weapon Linking are enabled. If false, this unit cannot use Weapon Linking.

NavConfig.description: If this is specified, overrides the Nav ODF dropped by this craft. If invalid, it ignores the setting.

NavIsCraftRace.description: If NavConfig is not set, and this is true, Nav Beacons dropped by this craft use the craft's Race. If false, uses the Team Race. If neither exist it falls back to ibnav.

NavIsDropped.description: If true, the Nav is dropped behind the craft like in BZ1/98R.

NavDropSound.name: NavDropSound
NavDropSound.description: If NavIsDropped is true, the sound file used upon dropping a Nav.

LeaveExplodeScorch.description: If false, won't darken the ground when it explodes.

RECYCLE_TASK_DIST.description: How far from the Recycler the object must get to Recycle.

PathingType.description: Pathing type for this Craft. Valid values are: -1 = auto, 0 = Hover, 1 = Walker, 2 = Person, 3 = Tracked, 4 = Flyer.

AvoidType.description: Avoidance type for this Craft. Valid values are: -1 = auto, 0 = None, 1 = force, 2 = plan.

attackRange.description: Range a target must get before considering to ATTACK.

TurretTankAttackRange.description: Range a target must get before considering to ATTACK. _Note:_ Only used by TurretTank Class.

TurretTankWaitRange.description: Range that a target must get before switching to WAIT state. _Note:_ Only used by TurretTank Class.

fireConeXBase.description: Base firing cone angle on X axis.

fireConeYBase.description: Base firing cone angle on Y axis.

AttackTaskBlastDist.description: How close AttackTask gets before opening fire.

BoidTaskAngleTweak.description: Amount it changes angle when pitching up or down.

BoidTaskPitchToSpeedRatio.description: How much it slows down when changing Pitch. The below values are for LandAnimalProcess AI:

CraftClassPilotMask.description: Bit Mask for use with [PersonClass]::PersonClassPilotProvides to filter which pilots can enter this a vehicle.

CraftClassPilotMatch.description: Bit Mask for use with PersonClassPilotMask and [PersonClass]::PilotClassPilotProvides to filter which pilots can enter this a vehicle.

CraftClassPilotProvides.description: Bit Mask for what use with [PersonClass]::PersonClassPilotMask and [PersonClass]::PersonClassPilotMatch to filter which pilots can enter this a vehicle.

RetargetOnStrafe.description: If this is true, when this unit is shot while engaging it's Target, and enters mode STRAFE to evade, it switches it's Target to the object that shot it.

EndSlideWhenCanHit.description: If true, exits SLIDE state as soon as it think it can hit it's Target.

MustBeLinedUpToHit.name: MustBeLinedUpToHit
MustBeLinedUpToHit.description: If this is true, AbleToHit calculation accounts for current heading and fire cone angles. _Note:_ Might not work very well on objects with Turrets.

MustBeLinedUpToFire.description: Same as MustBeLinedUpToHit but only applies to ArtillaryProcess AI. Defaults to true for Class: Artillary.

AITargetLocation.description: Target Location for where the AI aims at it's target. Valid values: -1 = default, 0 = center, 1 = high, 2 = low, 3 = left, 4 = right

GotoTaskHasLeader.name: GotoTaskHasLeader
GotoTaskHasLeader.description: If false, Goto task given to Groups will not use Leader/Follower behavior, and all units in the Group will make their own individual paths.

WingmanProcessAttackMines.name: WingmanProcessAttackMines
WingmanProcessAttackMines.description: If true, WingmanProcess AI will attacks Mines.

NonWingmanProcessAttackMines.name: NonWingmanProcessAttackMines
NonWingmanProcessAttackMines.description: If true, Non WingmanProcess AI will attack Mines.

AIWeaponMaskVsCombat.name: AIWeaponMaskVsCombat
AIWeaponMaskVsCombat.description: If this is >= 0, controls what weaponMask is used vs non isAssault objects.

AIWeaponMaskVsAssault.name: AIWeaponMaskVsAssault
AIWeaponMaskVsAssault.description: If this is >= 0, controls what weaponMask is used vs isAssault objects.

SitTaskEnemySearchDist.name: SitTaskEnemySearchDist
SitTaskEnemySearchDist.description: This is how far it will search for Targets while sitting idle. Max is the craft's rangeScan.

ClosestEnemyGoodEyes.name: ClosestEnemyGoodEyes
ClosestEnemyGoodEyes.description: If this is true, GetClosestEnemyWithin() AI function considers objects behind them, else it only considers things in front of them.

GunTowerProcessCheckCantHit.name: GunTowerProcessCheckCantHit
GunTowerProcessCheckCantHit.description: If this is true, GunTowerProcess will re-target if it can't hit it's current Target.

DoWeaponCanHitCheck.name: DoWeaponCanHitCheck
DoWeaponCanHitCheck.description: If false, won't perform a CanHit check before trying to fire a Weapon at it's Target. If true, will skip over weapons that can't hit.

IgnoreDestroyedTargets.name: IgnoreDestroyedTargets
IgnoreDestroyedTargets.description: If true, AI ignores things flagged as Destroyed.

IgnorePerceivedTeam.name: IgnorePerceivedTeam
IgnorePerceivedTeam.description: If this is true, AI will ignore an Enemy's PercievedTeam setting.

ScanLocalAmmo.name: ScanLocalAmmo
ScanLocalAmmo.description: If true, AIP, MorphTank switching, and MortarBikeProcess code that compares ammoRatio takes all the weapon's LocalAmmo into account.

AircraftAttackMustDeploy.name: AircraftAttackMustDeploy
AircraftAttackMustDeploy.description: If AirCraftFriend/Enemy AI is in use, and this is true, if it is Undeployed when ordered to Attack, it will Deploy to takeoff.

OffensiveProcessIsTenacious.name: OffensiveProcessIsTenacious
OffensiveProcessIsTenacious.description: If this is true, AI units on a Player's Team will keep attacking it's current Target.

OffensiveProcessIsTenaciousAITeam.name: OffensiveProcessIsTenaciousAITeam
OffensiveProcessIsTenaciousAITeam.description: If this is true, AI units on a non Player Team will keep attacking it's current Target.

OffensiveProcessIsDistractable.name: OffensiveProcessIsDistractable
OffensiveProcessIsDistractable.description: If this is true, units on a Player's Team that are shot while en-route to their Attack target, will switch to Target their object that shot them.

OffensiveProcessIsDistractableAITeam.name: OffensiveProcessIsDistractableAITeam
OffensiveProcessIsDistractableAITeam.description: If this is true, units on an AI's Team that are shot while en-route to their Attack target, will switch to Target their object that shot them.

AttackTaskUsesGroups.name: AttackTaskUsesGroups
AttackTaskUsesGroups.description: If true, Attack orders given to Groups will use Leader/Follower behavior. If false, units will path individually.

FireWhenCanHitFriends.name: FireWhenCanHitFriends
FireWhenCanHitFriends.description: If true, will fire even if a Friendly unit is in the line of fire.

SitAttackCheckAbleToHit.name: SitAttackCheckAbleToHit
SitAttackCheckAbleToHit.description: If true, when WAIT task times out or the unit is hit by enemy fire, it does a CanHit check before switching to ATTACK. Default is true for Class: TrackedVehicle and TurretTank.

DoBlastUsesFields.name: DoBlastUsesFields
DoBlastUsesFields.description: If this is true, skips terrain and obstacle avoidance in Pathing when in BLAST state.

SkipSitIfCanHit.name: SkipSitIfCanHit
